terrafactions.configuration.overlayEnabl: Show faction territory overlays in JourneyMap.
terrafactions.configuration.hud.tooltip: Configure the territory radar displayed on the HUD.
terrafactions.configuration.hudEnabled.t: Show the territory radar on the HUD.
terrafactions.configuration.scale.toolti: Set the size of the territory radar. A value of 1 is normal size.
terrafactions.configuration.horizontalPe: Set the radar position as a percentage of the screen width.
terrafactions.configuration.verticalPerc: Set the radar position as a percentage of the screen height.
terrafactions.configuration.anchor.toolt: Choose which point on the radar is attached to its configured screen position.
terrafactions.configuration.vulnerabilit: Flash the warning when the current faction territory is vulnerable.
terrafactions.configuration.opacity.tool: Set the territory radar background opacity.
terrafactions.configuration.factionInfoE: Show your faction power and Border/Core security indicators inside the territory radar.
